title: Stadium cleaning services in Arizona: Turning the Arizona Diamondbacks into sustainability leaders
summary: How ABM’s stadium cleaning services helped the Arizona Diamondbacks save 198,000 gallons of water, divert 42,000+ cups, and cut paper waste at Chase Field.
body_markdown:
Since becoming the Arizona Diamondbacks' cleaning partner in January 2024,[ABM has transformed Chase Field operations](https://www.abm.com/industries/sports-entertainment) by elevating cleaning performance, strengthening event execution, and implementing[forward-thinking sustainability initiatives](https://www.abm.com/solutions/sets/sustainability) now considered next-level within Major League Baseball. As one of the leading providers of stadium cleaning services in Arizona, ABM’s work at Chase Field shows what began as operational stabilization evolve into a multi-year sustainability partnership focused on water conservation, waste diversion, reusable programs, and smart restroom technology.


- 200 events annually
- 198,000 gallons of water saved in one month
- Paper waste reduced to 8%
- 42,000+ single-use cups diverted from landfills


> "Walking the ballpark is an absolute pleasure with ABM as our valued partner in janitorial and facility services. The management team is attentive, caring, and dedicated to providing a clean and safe environment for fans who visit Chase Field for Arizona Diamondbacks games, major concerts, and special events. We are especially grateful for ABM's efforts to continually improve the efficiency of the day-to-day operation." - Mike Rock, Vice President, Ballpark Operations


## Challenge


The Diamondbacks needed a partner with the expertise and staffing capacity to[deliver consistent cleaning processes](https://www.abm.com/solutions/service-family/cleaning-maintenance) , including detail work, post-event cleaning, and pressure washing. The leadership team sought out a partner they could trust to deliver consistent janitorial services throughout the stadium and meet their high standards, so they could focus on strategic work instead of operational oversight.


The Diamondbacks also wanted to pursue forward-looking environmental programs aligned with MLB's sustainability focus and Arizona's desert conservation needs. Achieving these goals required a strategic, innovative partner offering stadium cleaning services in Arizona that could scale alongside ambitious environmental targets.


## Solution


ABM implemented a comprehensive event-based janitorial strategy that addressed immediate operational needs while creating capacity for sustainability innovation.


ABM assumed full oversight responsibility, relieving client leadership of post-event cleaning management duties. The team established structured pre-event, event-time, and post-event cleaning processes with proper bowl-washing protocols. ABM also developed a scalable staffing model leveraging regional labor partnerships across three Phoenix venues, reinforcing its role as a trusted provider of arena cleaning services throughout the region.


### Multi-year sustainability initiatives


With operational stability established, ABM partnered with the Diamondbacks to expand venue sustainability programs:


- **Year 1:** The Diamondbacks were the first MLB team to launch a reusable cups program. In partnership with the Diamondbacks and its food and beverage partner, ABM began with a pilot in the All You Can Eat Suites and Cantina Bar with the goal of expanding across the entire suite level.
- **Year 2:** ABM implemented a water conservation initiative across the stadium using a data-driven bowl washing strategy. The program relies on heat mapping and third-inning visual verification for targeted cleaning in high-use zones.
- **Year 2:** The team also launched a smart restroom technology program using the KOLO coreless paper system that ensures full roll depletion before replacement. ABM staff rely on automated alerts to keep restrooms properly stocked.
- **Year 3:** ABM worked with the Diamondbacks and its food and beverage partner to expand the stadium's recycling and waste diversion program by transitioning to grab-and-go aluminum beverages to increase recyclable volume. There is now a dedicated recycling pick in the seating bowl. Data is tracked through MLB's sustainability software platform. Looking ahead, ABM will begin sorting waste in the stadium.


## Benefits


ABM's stable staffing model and improved post-event process execution have eliminated the operational oversight burden on Diamondbacks leadership. The ability to successfully manage 200+ events annually with 150-170 team members per event demonstrates scalable capacity ABM's cleaning services at Arizona's stadiums.


The Diamondbacks are assigning ABM project work that their in-house team would typically handle, with potential future opportunity for expanding scope.


Sustainability programs have delivered meaningful results:


- The water conservation program delivers significant impact in Arizona's desert climate. In the first month alone, the program resulted in 198,000 gallons of water saved and an approximately $2,500 reduction in costs.
- Smart restroom technology reduced paper waste to 8% (below the typical average of 15-20%).
- In two seasons, the reusable cup program has diverted over 42,000 single-use cups equaling 3,430 lbs. of waste from landfills. For the 2025 season, the return rate reached 82%.


> “ABM has been a crucial asset to the success of our Ballpark Operations department. They’re collaborative, proactive, and handle their operations with excellence. One thing that really stands out to me is the authentic care that ABM has for all they do. We love being on their team and having them on ours." - Rae Ehmann, Diamondbacks Manager, Events Services


By assuming full cleaning oversight and delivering consistent event execution, ABM freed the Diamondbacks to pursue ambitious sustainability goals. The result is a model that other MLB venues can follow as the league increases its environmental focus.

## FAQs


**How can stadium cleaning support sustainability goals?**


Stadium cleaning teams are key to any venue’s environmental performance, from water used in bowl washing to the paper and packaging discarded after every event. When cleaning operations are data-driven, they can track supply usage, heat-map high-traffic zones, and verify results in real time. Those insights directly support water conservation, waste diversion, and recycling. The Diamondbacks’ partnership with ABM shows how operational cleaning expertise and sustainability strategy work best when managed together.


**What should venues look for in a post-event cleaning partner?**


Venues should look for a partner with proven staffing capacity to handle high-volume, fast-turnaround work, a structured process for pre-event, event-time, and post-event cleaning, and the ability to scale up and down with the venue’s schedule. Just as important is a partner who can take full oversight off the venue's internal team, freeing leadership to focus on strategic priorities like guest experience and sustainability.


**What makes a reusable cup program successful?**


A successful reusable cup program depends on convenient return points, clear fan communication, and strong coordination between cleaning staff and food and beverage partners. High return rates, like the Diamondbacks’ 82%, come from making the return process nearly effortless for fans while ensuring cleaning teams can collect, sort, and recirculate cups efficiently between events.
